Patch 6.4 will see several changes to Allagan tomestones, including the addition of a new type of tomestone and revisions made to previously existing ones.

These revisions will result in the removal of all Allagan tomestones of aphorism. Players carrying this currency are encouraged to exchange it for Allagan tomestones of poetics before the start of Patch 6.4 maintenance.
New Tomestone
Allagan tomestones of comedy will be added, which can only be obtained after reaching level 90 with at least one class or job.
Regarding Existing Tomestones
Allagan Tomestones of Causality
The weekly obtainment cap for Allagan tomestones of causality will be removed.
* Maximum inventory limit of 2,000 still applies.
Allagan Tomestones of Astronomy
These tomestones will no longer be obtainable.
All trials and duties that currently yield these tomestones will instead offer Allagan tomestones of causality or the new Allagan tomestone currency.
Players will no longer be able to exchange these tomestones for items.
Although Allagan tomestones of astronomy will not be removed in Patch 6.4, items obtained through their exchanges will be made available through other means.
These tomestones may be exchanged for Allagan tomestones of causality.
* Exchange tomestones by speaking to Auriana in Revenant's Toll (X: 22.7 Y: 6.7).
Allagan Tomestones of Aphorism
With the release of Patch 6.4, all Allagan tomestones of aphorism in the possession of players will be removed.

* Players currently carrying Allagan tomestones of aphorism are advised to exchange them for Allagan tomestones of poetics by speaking with Auriana in Revenant's Toll (X: 22.7 Y: 6.7) prior to the scheduled maintenance for Patch 6.4.
Allagan Tomestones of Poetics
Allagan tomestones of poetics will be obtainable from trials and duties up to level 80, as well as the Duty Roulette.

Patch 6.18 brings a number of additions and refinements to the game, including the Data Center Travel system and the new Japanese data center, Meteor.
Players who logged out in a World that is not their Home World prior to the maintenance will be automatically returned to their Home World upon logging in.
Due to the number of players, there may be congestion issues immediately after the maintenance, so transfers may take some time to complete.
Should there be a need to restart the game during transfer, players will still be in the queue until the transfer process is completed.
The transfer process will not be interrupted if players minimize their screens.
If the target World is congested (e.g., due to login rush after maintenance or when logins are concentrated), that World will be temporarily disabled as a destination.

Due to the high number of visit requests per minute, the servers are currently unable to keep up with the high server load. We have temporarily suspended the Data Center Travel system and will gradually open this feature as we monitor the situation.

Read the full patch notes here.
The next patch is scheduled to hit the servers on May 22! Get a good look at what's coming with the brand new patch trailer:

Deep in the Glass Ocean, the great expanse of the Far East, lies an island recorded on no navigational charts. An island that seemingly appeared one day─an island that should not be. Recognizing its potential as a trading post, the brave and ambitious ventured forth to explore and claim it, only to discover an untamed land teeming with strange, monstrous beasts...
Master the elements and fight your way through these unknown lands!
Also make sure not to miss Hildibrand's newest adventures. You can find more details in today's patch notes, available on the Lodestone!

The worlds are now back online, and with them the updates from Patch 4.2 – Rise of a New Sun! There’s something for everyone in this massive update. Make sure to check out the enormous list of new content, updates and changes in the patch notes on the lodestone! For now, here is a quick selection:
Explore two new dungeons, Hell’s Lid and The Fractal Continuum (Hard)
Conquer the new raid, Omega: Sigmascape, with your battle-hardened comrades
Follow the legend of the samurai Tenzen, and face Byako in the Jade Stoa
Dive into the brand new The Feast PvP map, the Crystal Tower Training Grounds and explore the new team system and rules, that help to make fights shorter and more dynamic
Participate in new Beast Tribe quests and improve your reputation
Gather together with your Free Company and go on Subaquatic Voyages
… and many more!
The patch is now available to play, so what’s keeping you!? See you in-game!

Patch 4.1 brings a multitude of additions and refinements to the realm. Band together with your friends in search of the legendary land of Ivalice, explore the ancient city of Skalla, or face an old foe in a reimagining of your battle with the legendary dragon Shinryu. Whether you’re relaxing in the new residential area, Shirogane, or testing your mettle in PvP, there’s something for everyone in this exciting new update!
View the patch notes.

Read the patch notes.

It is with great pleasure that we announce the patch notes for Patch 4.01 are live. Be sure to check them out for a comprehensive list of additions and refinements to the world of Hydaelyn, including the raid Omega: Deltascape.
Read the patch notes.

Adventurers, you have come a long way since you started your journey in A Realm Reborn and fought your way through the lands surrounding Ishgard in Heavensward. Now, with today's update in Patch 3.56, you can experience the conclusion of the Heavensward main scenario! Take a leap towards the culmination of the Heavensward storyline and use the remaining time to ready yourself for Stormblood, our next massive expansion! Remember: You need to have finished the Heavensward scenario to start your travels towards Doma and Ala Mhigo in Stormblood.

Of course, there are many other updates with today’s patch. Challenging Alexander - The Creator has never been easier with its weekly restriction removed. And if you've been hungering for battle in the Wolves' Den, then steel yourself for the fourth season of the Feast. All this, and more awaits in the Far Edge of Fate!

Last but not least, if you want to show the amazing world of FINAL FANTASY XIV to your friends, they now have all the time in the world, as the 14-day time limit has been removed! They can adventure to their heart’s content for free up to level 35!
Read all about it in the 3.56 patch notes on the Lodestone.
Changes have been stirring in the Diadem, and House Haillenarte requests for adventurers to undertake new missions to explore these legendary floating isles.

With the addition of Patch 3.55b to the game, you can take part in the entirely revamped exploratory missions! If you’re level 60 and have an average item level of 179 or more, you can jump right in and face the trials given to gain access to the treasure coffer of your dreams!
• Explore the new Diadem with up to 24 players
• Face enemies on the hunt for new treasures
• Collect spoils and repair in small encampments within the Diadem
• Benefit from increased spirit bonding rates for battle gear
• Brave emergency missions
• Earn access to the Diadem with your gathering classes
• And much more!
Find out all the details in the official patch notes on the Lodestone!
